     def _encode_body(self, body):
         body_encoded = False
         try:
+            # Handle BytesIO objects
             if isinstance(body, io.BytesIO):
                 body = body.getvalue()
+            
+            # Handle AwsChunkedWrapper objects (used in S3 uploads)
+            if hasattr(body, 'body') and hasattr(body, 'chunk_size'):
+                # This is likely an AwsChunkedWrapper
+                if hasattr(body.body, 'read'):
+                    # If it has a read method, it's a file-like object
+                    body = body.body.read()
+                else:
+                    # Otherwise, just use the body attribute
+                    body = body.body
+            
+            # Handle bytes objects
             if isinstance(body, bytes):
                 body = base64.b64encode(body).decode("ascii")
                 body_encoded = True
-        except AttributeError:
+        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
             body = None
         return body, body_encoded
